subject.title: [Bug]: QQBot gateway never verifies heartbeat ACK — missed ACKs go undetected

question: What missed-ACK threshold and reconnect policy should QQBot use when the upstream protocol confirms ACKs but does not define a client timeout?
rationale: The source report supports adding observability of ACK receipt, but it does not establish that any particular timeout or forced-close policy is the existing product contract.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded watchdog
options.body: Define a conservative interval-based threshold, close stale sockets through the existing reconnect path, and require focused liveness and resume tests.

options.title: Track ACKs without enforcement
options.body: Record and expose ACK timing first, postponing automatic disconnects until production evidence supports a threshold.

options.title: Decline automatic enforcement
options.body: Keep transport liveness dependent on the platform or WebSocket lifecycle unless a real half-open incident demonstrates a user-visible failure.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded watchdog
recommendation.body: Define a conservative interval-based threshold, close stale sockets through the existing reconnect path, and require focused liveness and resume tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter has supplied the clearest currently available protocol and implementation analysis; code-history ownership still needs a local feature-history pass.
